overview_description.description:
Human Interest is a 401(k) provider that makes it easy for small and medium-sized businesses to help their employees save for retirement. The company built an end-to-end technology to solve administrative and compliance problems for small and medium-sized businesses. It also offers easy and affordable employee retirement plans and helped thousands of businesses across America to offer retirement accounts to their employees.

In 2015, the San Francisco, California-headquartered company was formed by Paul Sawaya and Roger Lee.

about_short_description.short_description: Human Interest is a 401(k) provider that helps employees of small and medium-sized businesses save for retirement.

product.name: 401(k) Plans
product.description: Employer-sponsored retirement plans for small and medium-sized businesses, with payroll integration, automated contributions, investment options, compliance administration, and employee account support.

product.name: 401(k) Plan Administration and Recordkeeping
product.description: Administrative and recordkeeping services that manage employee data, contributions, plan transactions, compliance workflows, disclosures, reporting, and retirement accounts for employer-sponsored plans.

product.name: 403(b) Plans
product.description: Employer-sponsored tax-advantaged retirement plans for eligible organizations, with payroll integration, automated contribution processing, investment options, compliance support, and participant account services.

identifier.value: Human Interest Advisors Investment Advisory Services

product.name: Human Interest Advisors Investment Advisory Services
product.description: Registered investment advisory services for Human Interest 401(k) and 403(b) plans, including investment selection, fund monitoring, model portfolios, and participant investment guidance.

product.name: IRA Accounts and Rollovers
product.description: Individual retirement accounts and rollover services that allow participants to consolidate eligible retirement savings and manage assets outside an employer-sponsored plan.

product.name: Solo 401(k) Plans
product.description: Individual 401(k) plans for eligible self-employed individuals and business owners without employees other than a spouse, supporting personal retirement contributions and plan administration.
